description: Phases 2/6 (android-to-desktop-checklist.md §3 document management): the app opens/saves user-chosen files via tauri-plugin-fs + tauri-plugin-dialog, scoped to user-selected paths only (dialog-granted, not a blanket filesystem allow). Drafts/recent-files/theme/autosave settings are all localStorage-backed, not filesystem — no app-data-dir grant is needed or held.
